title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Section 11 is a digression placed inside the analysis of the 'structure at infinity' of the moduli stacks M_{g,ν}. Grothendieck calls these 'multiplicités modulaires'. He needs a general formalism for the boundary of the Deligne–Mumford compactification, which is a normal crossings divisor in a smooth Deligne–Mumford stack.

Setting: X is a smooth analytic 'multiplicité' (an orbifold or analytic DM stack). He notes that the relative-analytic, topological ('hyp. topologiques ad hoc') or schematic settings would work equally well. D is a divisor with normal crossings, which he stresses is a purely local hypothesis on (X, D).

For each point x:
- I(x) is the finite set of local branches D_{x,i} of D through x. A marginal correction sets I(x) = ∅ for x not in D, so the construction is uniform on all of X.
- The 'germs of sub-multiplicities attached to D at x' are the intersections D_{x,J} = ∩_{i∈J} D_{x,i}, for J ⊂ I(x). D_{x,∅} is the germ X_x itself.
- These germs form a poset Δ_x = Δ_x(I(x)), ordered by inclusion. It is anti-isomorphic to the power set P(I(x)), since a larger J gives a smaller germ.
- Formula (149): codim(D_{x,J}, X_x) = card J.

Purpose, made explicit on the next page: build the 'dépliement' (unfolding) D_p. This is the analytic multiplicity of pairs (x, V), with x in D and V a codimension-p germ attached to D at x. In modern terms D_p is the normalization of the closure of the codimension-p stratum, Deligne's D^{[p]}. It comes with a finite map D_p → X. The next page also sets up poset embeddings I ↪ Δ, strictly compatible with codimension functions, to encode chains or flags of strata.

For M̄_{g,ν}, the D_p are the disjoint unions over stable graphs with p edges of the quotients (∏_v M̄_{g_v,n_v}) / Aut(G). The local cube posets Δ_x are the local form of the poset of graph contractions ('morphismes de généralisation') discussed on the neighbouring pages.
errors: Not an error in the mathematics, but the formalism is glossed: in a multiplicité (stack), the inertia group at x acts on the branch set I(x). So I(x) and Δ_x are only defined up to this action, or on an étale chart. This matters for the M_{g,ν} application, where graph automorphisms permute branches. The page does not address it here.
Equation numbering clash: (149) on this page duplicates (149) of the preceding section 12, and the section is numbered 11 after 12. This indicates the digression was inserted or reordered later.

ideas.what: Local branch set I(x) of a normal crossings divisor, and the poset of local strata germs D_{x,J}, anti-isomorphic to P(I(x)) with codim = card J.
ideas.modern_name: Local stratification of an NCD; face poset of the local cube; strata of the log structure
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard (Deligne, Théorie de Hodge II, 1971; later the log-geometry framework of Fontaine–Illusie and K. Kato)
ideas.where_published: Normal crossings divisors appear in SGA 1 (Exp. XIII, tame ramification, Grothendieck–Murre); this poset formalism specifically: unsure

ideas.what: Unfolding ('dépliement') D_p: the space of pairs (x, V) with V a codim-p local stratum germ, i.e. the normalization of the codim-p stratum closure, together with its map to X.
ideas.modern_name: D^{[p]} (normalization of p-fold intersections); boundary strata of M̄_{g,n} indexed by stable graphs
ideas.usually_credited_to: Deligne (Hodge II, 1971); for M̄_{g,n}, Deligne–Mumford and Knudsen
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses the 'structure à l'infini' of M_{g,ν} qualitatively; this construction is not given there in this form as far as I know

ideas.what: Working uniformly with smooth analytic 'multiplicités' (orbifolds/stacks), with the remark that topological or schematic variants would work.
ideas.modern_name: Normal crossings divisors on DM stacks / orbifolds

missed.claim: The page (with the next) begins encoding the stratification at infinity of M_{g,ν} purely by local cube posets Δ_x ≅ P(I(x))^op with codimension functions, and poset embeddings compatible with codim. This is essentially a combinatorial 'exit-path / stratification poset' description of the boundary, linked to graph contractions. It anticipates later combinatorial treatments of the boundary complex of M̄_{g,n} (e.g. Chan–Galatius–Payne) and exit-path categories, though only at a routine level here.
missed.quote: Ces germes forment un ensemble ordonné Δ_x = Δ_x(I(x)) anti-isomorphe à : P(I(x))
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Minor. It documents that Grothendieck approached the homotopy type at infinity of M_{g,ν} via the poset of strata, a viewpoint now central in tropical moduli and boundary complexes. The content on this page itself is standard.

deep.surprise_reason: The page sets up standard local combinatorics of a normal crossings divisor and its normalized strata (Deligne's D^{[p]}). It is well known and routine; its only interest is as scaffolding for the M_{g,ν} 'structure at infinity' programme.
transcription_corrections: The marginal note reads: 'il vaut mieux introduire pour tout x ∈ X, et pas seulement x ∈ D, I(x) = ∅ si x ∉ D'. It is written vertically in the left margin.
The line reads roughly 'les germes de sous-multiplicité attachées à D en x sont les intersections d'un ens fini de germes parmi les D_{x,i}, i ∈ I(x)'. 'parmi' replaces the '[?]'.
Δ_x = Δ_x(I(x)) is inserted above 'ensemble ordonné', which is correct. The word after the crossed-out 'si' is likely 'le germe correspondant à D_{x,J} (J ⊂ I(x)) étant de codim...'.
The section number is '11)', with a possibly overwritten first digit, despite following section 12 in the sequence.
